description: For a connected Starchild member: render NEW versions of a catalog song in chosen production styles, keeping the original vocal, using their credits (2 per style, 3 per style for songs over 3:30). Optional creative direction in plain words. Takes a few minutes; returns a job id for check_transform. Results also save to the member's Gen library on starchild.music. Use change_style first for styles that already exist (free).

direction.description: Optional creative direction, e.g. 'darker, slower, more acoustic guitar'

song.description: Song id, starchild.music/songs/... link, or exact title

name: transform_song
title: Make a new version
